overview: You died as Gaunt close enough to a skirt to smell the orris. You gave the line to the air a foot past Sir Robert's ear. He sat about three yards from your boots and did not move. The words were "inkie blots, and rotten parchment bonds".

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Died as Gaunt, and gave the line to the air.

parties.name: Sir Robert Cecil
parties.context: Sat three yards off, and did not move.

parties.name: Margaret, Lady Hoby
parties.context: Stayed seated. The orris was in the cloth beside the death.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Spoke Gaunt's line past Sir Robert's ear

summary: Spoke Gaunt's line past Sir Robert's ear
